# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/cosmictaserdev-creator/Convx/discussions) or the project [Discord](https://discord.gg/Ejeb4cmzfd).
- **Bugs:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/cosmictaserdev-creator/Convx/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Please test the latest [nightly build](https://github.com/cosmictaserdev-creator/Convx/releases/tag/2.0.0-nightly) first.
- **Feature requests:** open a [feature request](https://github.com/cosmictaserdev-creator/Convx/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security problems:** do not open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
